changelog: FoxDesk now ships complete runtime catalogs for 24 locales
Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu receive right-to-left layout, bidi isolation, and semantic directional icons
Chinese, Japanese, and Korean input now respects IME composition and CJK-aware search behavior
Locale-aware dates, numbers, plurals, fonts, e-mails, reports, and public views are available throughout the application
Language identifiers now support canonical regional and script tags such as pt-BR, zh-Hans, and zh-Hant
Translation catalog, placeholder, plural, CSS direction, and generated-file checks are enforced by the release pipeline
